milestones.title: A3 Agent foundation
milestones.summary: 统一LLM边界、状态上下文与编排入口。
milestones.problem: 早期原型的模型调用与业务控制需要可测试的统一边界。

milestones.title: A3 CRM and learning state
milestones.summary: 以SQLite持久化用户学习状态、偏好与学习事件。
milestones.chain: User → CRM State → Context → Agent → Response
milestones.problem: 对话需携带跨会话学习状态且用户数据需隔离。

milestones.title: A4 Stage 1 chat application
milestones.problem: 把命令行原型变成可持久化的本机聊天应用。
milestones.status: IMPLEMENTED; automated and HTTP evidence recorded

milestones.title: A4 Stage 2 files and RAG
milestones.summary: 解析学习资料并提供Session隔离检索与上下文构建。
milestones.chain: Upload → Parse → Embed → Retrieve → Context → LLM
milestones.problem: 需要从用户上传资料和长期知识库中检索可追溯上下文。

milestones.title: A4 Stage 3 Router and Web
milestones.summary: 三分类Router、受控Web Search、混合证据聚合。
milestones.chain: Input → Router → RAG/Web/No Tool → Evidence → LLM → Output
milestones.problem: 为请求选择合适证据来源并区分本地附件和公开网页。
milestones.status: IMPLEMENTED; offline TESTED; independent 98% NOT VERIFIED

milestones.title: MCP integration and productization
milestones.summary: Database/OCR MCP、Host工具规划、人工确认与版本中心。
features: Confirmation-gated writes, API Settings, session UX
milestones.chain: User → Agent/Planner → MCP Client → OCR → Review → Database → Verify → Response
milestones.problem: 以协议化隔离工具能力，并阻止未经核对的数据写入。
milestones.status: IMPLEMENTED; SDK protocol and isolated E2E TESTED

milestones.title: Conversation history and bounded context
milestones.summary: 由 Conversation 模块统一拥有会话、消息、附件元数据及受限上下文快照。
milestones.chain: Actor → Conversation Query → bounded ContextSnapshot → Agent → Conversation Command
milestones.problem: API/UI 需要通过稳定接口访问会话状态，避免跨模块直接触碰 Repository。
milestones.status: IMPLEMENTED; local contract, isolation, and HTTP recovery TESTED; OIDC isolation NOT VERIFIED

milestones.title: Bounded multi-step orchestration
milestones.summary: 以提案、澄清、确认和步骤状态实现一个受限的会话管理工作流。
milestones.chain: Proposal → User Confirmation → rename_session Command → get_session Query → list_sessions Query
milestones.problem: 多步骤请求需要可审计状态与业务读回，避免未确认或盲目重放写操作。
milestones.status: IMPLEMENTED for fixed workflow; loopback HTTP TESTED; general task planning NOT IMPLEMENTED

milestones.title: Optional follow-up suggestions
milestones.summary: 根据当前对话提供最多三条只读建议，用户点击后仅预填输入框。
features: No automatic message submission or business write
milestones.chain: Answer → optional Suggestion Query → suggestion buttons → input prefill
milestones.problem: 帮助继续学习而不改变对话或自动触发动作。
milestones.status: IMPLEMENTED; local HTTP and AppTest TESTED; deterministic topic coverage is limited

milestones.title: Integration quality and release boundary
milestones.summary: 整合回归、Actor 身份边界和部署草案，并明确本地通过与正式发布阻塞项。
features: Auth token/Actor boundary with fail-closed production path
Compose/Caddy deployment drafts and release gates
milestones.chain: Verified Actor → owned Commands/Queries → module tests → local HTTP acceptance → release gate review
milestones.problem: 功能集成后需要保留可追溯测试证据，并区分本地工程完成与公网生产验收。
milestones.status: Local integration TESTED; real OIDC, two-account public isolation, independent Router evaluation, and production deployment NOT VERIFIED

releases.status: historical local engineering beta acceptance record
